# TelegaFirst Hub API — LLM Reference

## Overview
The Hub API exposes TelegaFirst commerce, auth, and catalog data to external applications and MCP agents. All endpoints are versioned under `/api/v1`. Discovery endpoints (`/guide`, `/me`, `/openapi.json`) remain accessible to introspect the currently authenticated app.

## Authentication
AI clients use an OAuth access token issued to their own connection after the person approves access in Telegram and returns to the connection page in the browser, which completes the sign-in and hands the result back to the AI client. If that page was closed, or the client shows “connected” without access, the sign-in is not finished: delete the connection in the AI client and connect again. Send the opaque token as `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`; the MCP client manages its OAuth flow.

Server integrations use an ExternalApp API key: `X-Api-Key: tgf_api_<secret>` or the supported Bearer header.

Headless integrations use their own scoped M2MCredential; this is a separate real credential kind, not an ExternalApp or a person session.

Surface/customer sessions authorize their own surface; they do not establish the OAuth connection of an AI client.

Read `https://telegafirst.com/auth.md` and `https://telegafirst.com/docs/authorization.md` for consent, current permissions and revocation.

## Endpoints
### /api/v1/users
- `GET /api/v1/users` _(scopes: pull:users)_ — List tenant users as full cards by their local sequence
- `GET /api/v1/users/{id}` _(scopes: pull:users)_ — Read a tenant user and permitted relation projections
- `PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/recommendations` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Replace the personal suggestions for a buyer.

### /api/v1/payments
- `GET /api/v1/payments` _(scopes: pull:payments)_ — List tenant payments with their related user and order ids
- `GET /api/v1/payments/{id}` _(scopes: pull:payments)_ — Read a tenant payment by its id
- `POST /api/v1/payments/credential-links` _(scopes: payments:config)_ — A one-time CRM link where the owner enters the provider secrets; valid 5 minutes. The answer also carries webhook_setup (what the owner sets in the provider cabinet first, with our address) and say_to_user. No secret travels through this API.

### /api/v1/tools
- `POST /api/v1/tools/sales/manual-sales` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Create an unpaid CRM order in the in-progress (taken) stage: a buyer user_id with lines (catalog_id, optional combination_key, quantity, optional unit price; an event ticket line may name ticket_holders, one per ticket or null; a booking service line names its booking_slot: resource_id, start_at, optional end_at, optional guests; its add-ons go in selected_options, an add-on taken more than once with its pieces in option_quantities), or one registration_id. payment_mode is manual, invoice or deferred; the buyer receives the order card in chat. settlement records a sale already paid outside the platform as a paid order. delivery_method_id is refused until delivery reaches this path. Idempotency-Key must contain a non-whitespace character. The durable 30-day receipt is keyed by client, operation and key; replay rechecks actor admission and returns the stored result with replayed=true.
- `GET /api/v1/tools/external-content-publish/{draft_handle}` _(scopes: content:read)_ — Read the full draft lifecycle and finalized media
- `DELETE /api/v1/tools/external-content-publish/{draft_handle}` _(scopes: content:write)_ — Cancel a pending content draft

### /api/v1/sales
- `POST /api/v1/sales/orders/{order_id}/invoice` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Issue payment for a tenant-local unpaid order. An order with its own payment mode gets the provider links on its order card when the buyer has a receipt contact (delivery queued); without one the answer is delivery order_page — the Pay button on the order card opens the order page, which asks for the contact. Manual, invoice, deferred and online-prepay orders are issued; an order paid on site or owing nothing is refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION. A one-product chat order queues its invoice card. An order whose invoice is already out is refused with ALREADY_SENT unless the body is {"reissue": true}: then the invoice is reissued for the current sum, the buyer gets a new one and the earlier payment links stop working. queued acknowledges the durable effect; buyer delivery is outbox-owned. Idempotency-Key must contain a non-whitespace character. The durable 30-day receipt is keyed by client, operation and key; replay rechecks actor admission and returns the stored result with replayed=true.
- `POST /api/v1/sales/orders/{order_id}/mark-paid` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Record an actual cash, bank transfer or transfer settlement after an explicit switch to manual payment. payment_id is null when no new payment was recorded. Idempotency-Key must contain a non-whitespace character. The durable 30-day receipt is keyed by client, operation and key; replay rechecks actor admission and returns the stored result with replayed=true.
- `POST /api/v1/sales/orders/{order_id}/unmark-paid` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Reverse a manual settlement: payment_id is the number of the payment recorded by hand (mark-paid or a manual sale), as the order lists it. That payment is cancelled by a compensating entry, never edited; the order is open and unpaid again, and the private access that payment opened is taken back unless another payment keeps it. confirm_reversal must be true. A provider payment is refused: it is a refund. Needs the refund right of the person behind the credential (ACTION_FLAG_MISSING). A repeat with the same payment_id answers outcome already_cancelled and changes nothing.
- `POST /api/v1/sales/orders/{order_id}/payment-type` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Switch how the buyer pays an open, unpaid order: manual (the buyer's card loses the payment-provider buttons; record the payment with mark-paid) or online (the provider links are issued again; needs a connected payment provider and an order card sent to the buyer, else ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE). An order already on that branch answers outcome unchanged. A card of several items is refused with FAILED_PRECONDITION; a paid order with ORDER_ALREADY_PAID.

### /api/v1/delivery-methods
- `GET /api/v1/delivery-methods` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — The tenant delivery methods.
- `POST /api/v1/delivery-methods` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Create a delivery method; a paid kind needs a complete tax_profile (DELIVERY_TAX_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE).
- `PATCH /api/v1/delivery-methods/{id}` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Change a delivery method.
- `DELETE /api/v1/delivery-methods/{id}` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Delete a delivery method.
- `PUT /api/v1/delivery-methods/{id}/active` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Switch a delivery method on or off.
- `GET /api/v1/delivery-methods/{id}/versions` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — The stored versions of a delivery method, newest first, paginated by before_version.
- `POST /api/v1/delivery-methods/{id}/restore` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Put a delivery method back to a stored version; the copy passes today's rules and becomes the next version. Confirmed orders keep their shipping line.

### /api/v1/delivery-quote-requests
- `GET /api/v1/delivery-quote-requests` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — The live delivery quote requests, paginated by after_id.
- `POST /api/v1/delivery-quote-requests/{id}/quote` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Name the delivery price for an open request; If-Match carries its version. The buyer alone accepts a quote.

### /api/v1/orders
- `POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/refunds` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — A body with scope prepares a refund and asks the owner for approval; a body with action_id runs the approved one.
- `POST /api/v1/orders/quote` _(scopes: orders)_ — quoteOrder
- `GET /api/v1/orders` _(scopes: pull:orders)_ — listOrders
- `POST /api/v1/orders` _(scopes: orders)_ — createOrder
- `GET /api/v1/orders/{id}` _(scopes: pull:orders)_ — getOrder
- `POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/refresh-payment-urls` _(scopes: orders)_ — refreshPaymentUrls
- `POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/link-user` _(scopes: orders)_ — linkOrderUser
- `POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/composition` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Apply one change to the composition of an open, unpaid order: remove_line, set_quantity, set_line_price, add_line or set_variant (the line takes another variant of its product, keeping its quantity and note). Prices are recalculated by the platform under its pricing rules; an unpaid payment link is reissued for the new amount and the old one no longer pays the order. MCP agents prepare the same change with prepare_order_composition_change first.

### /api/v1/comments
- `GET /api/v1/comments` _(scopes: dialogs:read)_ — Comments of one entity.
- `POST /api/v1/comments` _(scopes: dialogs:write)_ — Add an operator comment; the author is the calling credential.
- `DELETE /api/v1/comments/{id}` _(scopes: dialogs:write)_ — Delete a comment: a credential its own, the owner any.

### /api/v1/catalog
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/{catalog_id}/combinations` _(scopes: catalog:read)_ — Priced combinations of a product with their stock.
- `PUT /api/v1/catalog/{catalog_id}/combinations` _(scopes: catalog:write)_ — Add or replace combinations by key; at most 5 axes and 50 combinations (VARIANT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED).
- `POST /api/v1/catalog/{catalog_id}/combinations/remove` _(scopes: catalog:write)_ — Remove combinations and their stock counters by key.
- `PUT /api/v1/catalog/{catalog_id}/stock` _(scopes: catalog:write)_ — Set the stock of a product or one combination: null removes the limit, 0 closes it.
- `GET /api/v1/catalog` _(scopes: catalog:read)_ — listCatalog
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/search` _(scopes: catalog:read)_ — Structured search over what a buyer can see (switched on, listed, showcase scope): words in the title or description, categories, a price range in one currency, availability, five sorts. One page per call; follow next_cursor. A page filtered by availability can be empty while has_more is true.
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/{id}` _(scopes: catalog:read)_ — getCatalogItem
- `PATCH /api/v1/catalog/{id}` _(scopes: catalog:write)_ — Requires an API key credential, supplied in X-Api-Key or Authorization: Bearer tgf_*. Surface-session JWT credentials are not accepted for this operation.
- `DELETE /api/v1/catalog/{id}` _(scopes: catalog:write)_ — Soft delete: the item leaves the showcase, storefront and listings and can no longer be bought; existing orders keep their own item snapshot. A repeat answers deleted:true again. Undo with content publish intent RESTORE; to pause sales only, PATCH is_active:false. Requires an API key credential, supplied in X-Api-Key or Authorization: Bearer tgf_*.

### /api/v1/events
- `PUT /api/v1/events/{event_id}/capacity` _(scopes: events:write)_ — Set the seats of an event, sold ones included. The seats on sale are the smaller of capacity and target_registrations, and the capacity in the response is that limit; null leaves target_registrations as the limit, and with neither set the event has no limit. The same write as capacity in updateEvent: a limit at or below the seats sold closes the sale and cancels no sold seat; 409 EVENT_SEATS_BELOW_HELD when buyers hold more seats in checkout than the new limit leaves free; 422 INVALID_INPUT when capacity exceeds target_registrations.

### /api/v1/promo-codes
- `GET /api/v1/promo-codes` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Promo codes, paginated by after_id.
- `POST /api/v1/promo-codes` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Create a promo code.
- `PATCH /api/v1/promo-codes/{id}` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Change a promo code.
- `DELETE /api/v1/promo-codes/{id}` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Delete a promo code; one already redeemed is only switched off.
- `PUT /api/v1/promo-codes/{id}/paused` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Pause or resume a promo code.
- `GET /api/v1/promo-codes/{id}/usage` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Redemptions of a promo code by state.
- `GET /api/v1/promo-codes/{id}/versions` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — The stored versions of a promo code, newest first, paginated by before_version.
- `POST /api/v1/promo-codes/{id}/restore` _(scopes: pricing:write)_ — Put a promo code back to a stored version; the copy passes today's rules and becomes the next version. Redemptions orders already used stay.

### /api/v1/preselection-cards
- `POST /api/v1/preselection-cards` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Send a buyer a card with a product already chosen. No order is made; the buyer opening the card starts the checkout.

### /api/v1/content
- `POST /api/v1/content/publish` _(scopes: content:write)_ — Write a pack of content cards into Settings topics
- `GET /api/v1/content/publish/{draft_handle}` _(scopes: content:read)_ — Poll the unified content write outcome

### /api/v1/storefront
- `POST /api/v1/storefront/checkout` _(scopes: orders)_ — Start anonymous checkout for an admitted public form

### /api/v1/sessions

### /api/v1/carts
- `POST /api/v1/carts` _(scopes: orders)_ — createCart
- `GET /api/v1/carts/{code}` _(scopes: orders)_ — getCart
- `POST /api/v1/carts/{code}/items` _(scopes: orders)_ — addCartItem
- `PATCH /api/v1/carts/{code}/items/{line_no}` _(scopes: orders)_ — patchCartItem
- `DELETE /api/v1/carts/{code}/items/{line_no}` _(scopes: orders)_ — deleteCartItem
- `POST /api/v1/carts/{code}/checkout` _(scopes: orders:write)_ — Checkout Handoff (§17.5): hands the Cart composition at If-Match to the tenant checkout. No order is made here and no total is accepted from the caller; the buyer signs in and confirms on the returned page, and the result arrives through the order.* webhooks.

## Events
Domain events are delivered via webhook (HMAC-SHA256 signed) and SSE.
- `order.created` — Order was created (paid or pending).
- `order.updated` — Order was amended, its payment links were refreshed, or a user was linked.
- `order.linked` — Anonymous order linked to a user.
- `order.expired` — Order expired without payment.
- `payment.succeeded` — Payment reached succeeded state.
- `payment.failed` — Payment moved to failed.
- `payment.expired` — Payment expired without being paid.
- `subscription.updated` — Subscription was canceled, expired or renewed; `state` names which.
- `user.session.approved` — Approval session approved by user in Telegram.
- `user.session.denied` — Approval session denied.
- `user.session.expired` — Approval session expired.
- `button.clicked` — Interactive button clicked inside the messenger.
- `webhook.auto_disabled` — App webhook auto-disabled after consecutive failures.

## Rate limits
Rate limits are per API key. Tiers: free (60 rpm), starter (300), pro (600), enterprise (1200+). Headers `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and `Retry-After` indicate current state.

## Error codes
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400) — Zod validation failure.
- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401) — missing or invalid credentials.
- `FORBIDDEN` (403) — scope or zone mismatch.
- `NOT_FOUND` (404) — resource unknown.
- `CONFLICT` (409) — state transition or idempotency conflict.
- `RATE_LIMITED` (429) — per-key or per-IP rate limit exceeded.
- `INTERNAL` (500) — unexpected server error.
